name: w1am
description: w1am's Claude Code plugins, installable as one marketplace: spoken replies when a turn ends, a desktop password prompt for sudo, project names on tmux windows, and a set of engineering skills.

plugins.name: friday
plugins.description: When Claude Code finishes a reply, plays a chime and reads the answer aloud, so you can work elsewhere and still follow along without watching the terminal.

plugins.name: sudo-askpass
plugins.description: When a command needs sudo, asks for your password in a desktop dialog instead of a terminal Claude Code cannot type into, so admin commands finish on the first try.

plugins.name: tmux
plugins.description: Names the tmux window after the project for as long as a session runs, so several open sessions stay easy to tell apart, and hands naming back to tmux on exit.

plugins.name: workbench
plugins.description: Slash commands for recurring engineering work: review the names in changed code, untangle knotted business logic, draft release notes for a version range, explain a business term to a newcomer, and copy the current session id.
